caption:
Affle just dropped $420 million to buy Perion, expanding hard into connected TV and retail media ads. Translation: soon you will not even be able to watch Netflix in peace without a targeted ad finding you.

Would you pay extra to never see an ad on your TV again? 👇

post.news: Affle is buying Perion for $420 million. The deal helps Affle expand into connected TV and retail media advertising.
post.take: Four hundred million dollars to make sure ads find you on your smart TV too. Nowhere is safe.
post.insight: Tech companies are buying up screen space everywhere to follow eyeballs from phones straight to living room TVs.
